detailed_description: The URL Parser breaks one URL into browser-parsed components using the built-in URL API. Enter or edit a URL and the tool displays protocol, hostname, port, pathname, search string, hash, origin, host, and query parameters when present. Invalid URLs show a simple error message, and each displayed value has its own copy button. It is a quick inspection helper rather than a redirect checker, security scanner, or full RFC compliance validator.
usage_steps: Enter or edit a complete URL in the input field.
Review the parsed protocol, hostname, port, pathname, search, hash, origin, and host values.
Check the query parameters section when the URL includes a query string.
Copy any displayed component with its adjacent copy button.
usage_examples: Inspect the query parameters in a copied tracking URL.
Check whether a URL includes an explicit port, path, search string, or hash fragment.
Copy the hostname or origin from a long URL while preparing notes.
Compare a few edited URL variants by changing the input field.
